mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, it predicts a near-term decline in real interest rates, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (monthly employment) above the prior quarter's average, accompanied by a decline in UNRATE, signals labor market strength that supports equity risk appetite and yields positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > Q1 average AND UNRATE < prior month UNRATE
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (monthly industrial production) grows by more than 2% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it indicates accelerating economic demand, which is associated with positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST[month] > HOUST[previous month] * 1.02 AND HOUST[following month] > HOUST[month]
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the double-month-over-month production surge.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (monthly index, 2017=100) below 110 for three consecutive months suggests supply-side constraints, which typically precede equity market overvaluation and negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the supply contraction window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in CPIAUCSL (CPI) below 208 over the prior 4 months indicates deflationary pressure, which tends to reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the deflationary window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months during a non-recession regime, it reflects weaker labor market resistance, which can support risk-on sentiment and positive S&P 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 2 consecutive months AND not in recession regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the low unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and PAYEMS above their prior quarter averages suggest robust demand, which is associated with positive S&P 60-day forward returns when combined over a rolling 3-month window.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > Q1 average AND PAYEMS > Q1 average (rolling 3 months)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative during the combined demand surge.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RSAFS (retail sales) above 370,000 for three consecutive months indicates consumer confidence, which can precede equity overvaluation and produce negative S&P 20-day forward returns in a mature economy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite strong retail sales.
